title: Percival
summary: An AI healthcare platform, built as a Yhacks hackathon project, that automates data entry from text and speech, anonymizes patient information, and produces treatment recommendations. Its flask_app/pdfs/ml/synth.py script uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to fit and sample synthetic healthcare data, presumably to anonymize or augment patient records.
needs: unclear whether synth.py is actually invoked from the main app pipeline or left as a standalone script
